str.text: Groove tracking sensitivity value is less than zero. Choose a value between 0 and 1 to begin a weld with groove tracking.
str.desc: Tracking sensitivity can only have values between 0.0 and 1.0.

str.text: Groove tracking could not begin in replay mode since no corrections are available from the previous pass. Record a pass in amperage mode before using replay.
str.desc: To enable groove tracker in 'replay' mode a previous pass should have been run in 'amperage' mode to store corrections for that pass.
